parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, border/facility restriction, or documented police/border targeting of visitors; courts have repeatedly recognised self-determined/third-gender identity, albeit with implementation gaps that are mainly resident-facing and not documented as visitor document rejection. Countervailing this, a November 2024 ground report documents discrimination in public and government institutions and frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities, with deeply rooted stigma, rising political hostility/death threats from supporters, and no documented working visitor remedy or prosecutions. This is tier-3 societal hostility with thin recourse, not universal state exposure or organised targeting, placing it in Elevated-to-Reduced borderline rather than the 0.65+ acceptance-with-working-protections tier.
